plain: A direction found by averaging a model's internal numbers for one group of inputs, averaging them for another group, and subtracting.
eli5: Average the "ouch" sentences, average the "no ouch" sentences, and the gap between them points toward "ouch".
technical: The vector v = mean<sub>s∈P</sub> h<sub>s</sub> − mean<sub>s∈C</sub> h<sub>s</sub> between the activations of a target set P and a contrast set C at one layer; the standard recipe for refusal, steering and concept directions, which also absorbs any other property that differs systematically between the sets.
